artifact.canonical_name: Understanding and Evaluating Claw-like Agent Security Through a Computer-Systems Lens

sources.title: Primary source 1: http://arxiv.org/abs/2606.30755v1

claims.text: The authors frame persistent Claw-like agents as computer systems and introduce SafeClawArena for cross-component security evaluation.

limitations.text: The evidence is the authors' arXiv paper/model card and reported evaluations; results are not independently reproduced in this Evidence review.

targets.target: verify benchmark/system model and tested agents
targets.finding: SafeClawArena contains 406 adversarial tasks spanning four attack surfaces and evaluates three Claw-like platforms with five frontier LLMs in containerized replicas with taint tracking.
